free_tier.stated: Unlimited storage is stated; video files up to 15GB; inactive files are deleted after 60 days without views or downloads.

egress.terms: No download volume or speed figure is published on the page read.

interface_detail: Web upload and remote upload from other hosts; no API was read.
chaining: Remote upload copies videos from other hosts, so the host can sit behind a link generator that fetches other hosts.

limits.value: inactive files are deleted after 60 days without views or downloads

binding_note: Sixty days without a view removes a file, which binds before the 15GB cap for any file that is stored and not watched.

identity_cost.detail: The page says users share and monetise videos, which implies an account; the registration form was not read.

confidence_note: Cap, retention and storage read on the vendor home page FAQ. Cheapest paid tier: unverified: no price page was found (the premium URL answered HTTP 404).
